gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.title: &6Engineering
An engineer’s hammer, the main tool of a real engineer, with this you will build all of your multi-block structures.
To build a coke oven, place the bricks in a 3x3x3 cube, and then click the center block on any of the four side with your hammer. In a coke oven you can get coke coal and creosote.
Coke coal can be obtained in a coke oven from ordinary coal.
Creosote can be obtained in a coke oven, it is created upon receipt of coke coal. Creosote is needed to create treated wood planks.
Planks made of treated wood are created from a bucket of creosote and any planks. You will need these planks in the future.
Wooden barrels are simple containers in which you can store up to 12 fluid buckets.
Treated sticks are also created, like ordinary sticks, only from treated boards. Using these sticks, you can create, for example, part of the water wheel.
Parts of the water wheel will be needed to create a full-fledged water wheel.
To create a blast furnace, it is necessary to put the bricks in the 3x3x3 area, and then press RMB with the engineer hammer on any side. Using the blast furnace you can create steel!
A steel ingot is created in a blast furnace. Please note that the blast furnace uses coke coal, instead of the usual one. Steel ingots will be very useful to you in the future, for example, to create a 5x5 workbench.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests10: Black iron slate is needed to create components, catalysts and, of course, new workbenches!
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests11: The basic workbench is the same as the usual workbench. But with the basic workbench you can create an advanced workbench!
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests12: An advanced workbench has a 5x5 craft grid, which allows you to create more interesting crafts.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests13: The blades of the chicken mill are needed to collect a full -fledged windmill.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests14: A windmill is a free and simple way to produce energy, although not very effective.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests15: A water wheel is a fairly simple way to rotate a kinetic generator. The speed of rotation of the wheel depends on the water flowing, therefore, to obtain optimal results, you need to direct the water in a semicircle from top to bottom along one side. You can also put up to 3 water wheels with each other.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests16: With the help of the engineer's wire cutters, you can create various wires and more.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests17: Copper wires can be combined into an LV wire coil and more.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests18: A coil of a low-voltage wire can be used as a wire, oddly enough, but do not touch it when it's powered.
A coil of a low-voltage wire
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests19: The coil of the copper wire is used in many recipes, but the main thing is a kinetic generator.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests20: The kinetic generator produces energy from the kinetic power of water wheels and windmills. To make it work, connect a kinetic generator to water wheels or windmills.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests21: The thermoelectric generator is another option for generating electricity, it works without the use of any mechanical parts, instead it uses a temperature gradient between two heat and cold sources.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests22: To build a Kiln, place kiln bricks in 2x2x2 cube and then click with the hammer. In the Kiln you can create various alloys.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests23: Constant is an alloy of copper and nickel.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests24: Electrum is an alloy of silver with gold.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests25: The engineer’s crafting table is a simple improvement to a normal crafting table. The engineer’s crafting table can keep objects in it's UI, and it also has a small inside inventory.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests26: An engineer's workbench is a professional workbench of an educated engineer. It is mostly used to create items using blueprients.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests27: Equips the shield by pressing a button.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests28: Using this blueprint, you can create special metal molds on the engineer's workbench.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests29: Using this blueprint, you can create special crafting components on the engineer's workbench.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests30: A metal press is an automated method of shaping metal.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests31: Ore crushing is an effective way to increase the resource output, since each ore crushes into two dusts, which can then be melted. This industrial crusher is a quick way to do it.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests32: The sawmill is a machine that cuts wooden logs into neatly laid boards. The machine works in two stages: first, the bark is cut off from the log, and then, using a saw blade, it is cut into pieces.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests33: During both stages, a sawdust bi-product is created that and can be extracted through the port on the front panel of the machine.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests35: Using coal sand, you can create fluid pipes.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests36: An Industrial fermenter is a multi-block structure that extracts ethanol from certain fruits, grains and vegetables using fermentation.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests37: A refinery is a complex multi-block structure that can process one or two liquids into different ones.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests38: A squeezer is a multi-block structure that squeezes juice or oil from organic materials using a large piston.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests39: Just ethanol, useful for creating biodiesel.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests40: Just oil, useful for creating biodiesel.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests42: The mixer is a multiblock structure that dissolves solids into fluids, mixing them together.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests43: You can make concrete using a bucket of concrete, who would've known!
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests44: The diesel generator is a powerful source of electricity, which works on a biodesel or on another fuel fuel.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests45: Cool block which can be used as a decoration.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests46: A fence made of treated wood can be used as a conventional fence. But I would recommend you use it to create a bunker or a liquid tank.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests47: In the silo you can store up to 41,472 items of the same type, which makes it an ideal storage for trash objects, such as cobblestone, earth, seeds, etc.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests48: A tank is a multiblock that can store up to 512 buckets of a liquid.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests49: An improved blast furnace is a much more professional way to create steel. Not only does it allow the automation of in- and outputs, but it can also be outfitted with preheaters to accelerate the refinement process by addition of hot air.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests50: The arc furnace is a massive structure used to quickly smelt metals. It consists of a steel vat topped with electrodes which heat up the metal.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests51: The excavator is one of the pinnacles of modern engineering. It is able to dig up minerals from veins inaccessible to by normal mining.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests52: The excavator consists of two parts: the engine and the bucket.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests53: With the help of a core sample drill, you can find out which minerals are hidden under the earth.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests54: Using the windmill sails, you can increase the amount of energy produced. To do this, you need to press RMB in the center of the windmill.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests55: Blast furnace preheaters accelerate the refinement process by addition of hot air.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests56: An insulated LV wire coil can be used as a conventional coil of wires, except it won't electrocute you if you ever touch it.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests57: A sawblade is needed for a sawmill.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests58: A sawblade is needed for a sawmill.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests59: Infusion altar allows you to create seeds which can be used to grow resources!
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests60: Infusion Pedestal is needed to create various seeds on the infusion altar.
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests61: Just so you don't get lost :)
gloomyrise.immersiveengineering.quests63: A new stage of Gloomy Rise begins - you can now craft seeds and use them to grow various resources.
This is very important, as in the future you will need a large amount of different resources. Therefore, it might be a good idea to think about making an autofarm using all of your seeds.

In this modpack you will find lots of activities, such as: exploring the world, fighting bosses, using various types of magic and technology, automating, exploring various dimensions and much more!

gloomyrise.intro.quests0.tasks0.title: Welcome...
gloomyrise.intro.quests0.rewards1.title: Telegram Channel of the main developer.

gloomyrise.intro.quests1.description1: Connect a guidebook with The Akashic Tome in the crafting grid to merge them. After that, you simply have to choose the right book using RMB

gloomyrise.intro.quests1.tasks0.title: Akashic Tome

gloomyrise.manaartifice.title: &6Magic Foundations
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests0.descript: Vinteum ore can be found in the mines. Who would've thought.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests1.descript: In order to get vinteum dust, you need to grind the ore using a millstone or crushing wheels.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests2.descript: Runeforge is a furnace that runs on ambient magic in the air. It requires no additional fuel source.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests3.descript: Vinteum coated iron can me melted into regular vinteum ingots.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests4.descript: Vinteum will be used for a lot of magical crafts, such as manaweaving altar and wand.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests5.descript: Manaweaving is a process of imbuing an item with your mana. It can be used in spells, rituals, runes and much more.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests6.descript: You will need bone ash to create wizard chalk and arcane compound.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests7.descript: With the help of wizard chalk you can draw sigils for ritals!
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests8.descript: Practicioner's pouch allows you to instantly draw the ritual you want. Read the Codex Arcana for more info.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests9.descript: An arcane compound is used to create arcane ash.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests10.descrip: Arcane ash is needed to create purified screw dust.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests11.descrip: Using the purified vinteum dust, you can create many useful items, such as a runescribing table or a runic anvil.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests12.descrip: Purified vinteum coated iron can be melted into purified vinteum ingots.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests13.descrip: Purified vinteum ingots allow you to create create tools for runescribing, namely a runesmith's hammer and chisel.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests14.descrip: Overheated purified vinteum ingots are needed to create runes from their template on a runic anvil, as well as to craft a construct workbench.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests15.descrip: Overheated vinteum, mostly useful for runesmithing.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests16.descrip: The runescribing table can be used to scribe rune patters using a blank pattern and several tools, such as runesmith's hammer and chisel.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests17.descrip: The runic anvil can be used to actually make runes out of patterns.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests18.subtitl: Hogwarts is just around the corner!
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests18.descrip: Using this table you can create your own spells!
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests19.descrip: Vellum can be obtained by curing skin in water by clicking RMB. It will come in handy for spells.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests20.descrip: Manaweaving altar can be used for various crafts, but you'll need a manaweaving wand to do anything.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests21.descrip: Occulus is a block that will help you on your journey to becoming a mage. It will show what you need to do to unlock new things from this mod.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests22.descrip: Arcanist's ink is useful for creating your own spells.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests23.descrip: A runesmith's hammer is needed to create runes.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests24.descrip: A runesmith's chisel is needed to create runes.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests25.descrip: Rune plates can be turned into rune patterns by melting them in the runeforge.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests26.descrip: Using the rune pattern, you can write a rune on the table for writing runes.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests27.descrip: A mote of air is created via a ritual. It's mostly useful to get a slipstream generator, however it has multiple other uses.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests28.descrip: The slipstream generator will push you in the direction of your camera.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests29.descrip: A mote of magic is created via a ritual. It's mostly useful to get a mana crystal, however it has multiple other uses.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests30.descrip: The mana crystal will gives you the effect of mana regeneration when you are standing next to it.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests31.descrip: You can store all of your spells in a Book of Rote to avoid vasting inventory space.
gloomyrise.manaartifice.quests32.descrip: You can create a real golem using the construct workbench!

gloomyrise.other.quests0.description0: The quartz grindstone allows you to grind ore into dust. In order to crush the ore, you need to put the handle on top of the crusher, and then turn it.
gloomyrise.other.quests1.description0: The time accumulates while the bottle is in your inventory. With enough time you can accelerate almost any block.
gloomyrise.other.quests1.tasks0.title: Time in a bottle
gloomyrise.other.quests3.description0: Improved magnet. Has increased range of collecting objects.
gloomyrise.other.quests4.description0: A great item for large scale building .

gloomyrise.other.quests5.description0: A crafting stick allows you to open a workbench anywhere. The only downside is that it does not have its own inventory.
gloomyrise.other.quests6.description0: An advanced crafting stick works the same, but retains its inventory. Can be used as a backpack :)
gloomyrise.reliquary.title: &6Reliquary
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests0.subtitle: There is a risk of balance loss!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests0.description: &6Alckahestry Tome&r is a relic that accumulates a charge of Redstone or Glowstone dust in order to double almost any resources.
To &2Activate&r a relic you need to hold &eSHIFT&r and then click &eRMB&r, making it so it automatically absorbs and glow/red stone from your inventory.
To &2Double&r any resources, you have to put a relic in the crafting grid alongside the resource you want. This will double the resource, but drain some power from the tome.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests1.subtitle: Salvation from the falling damage!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests1.description: &6Angelic Feather&r is a relic that saves its owner from falling off a big height by absorbing the damage and consuming owner's hunger. Also gives permanent jump boost.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests2.subtitle: Undead hates this one simple trick!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests2.description: &6Cross of Mercy&r is a relic that causes additional damage against undead, and also has an increased level of looting.
In addition, it is made out of gold, therefore it is more enchantable, but has less durability. Therefore, it's better to use it alongside the &2Touchstone of Midas&r.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests3.subtitle: The relic hidden by Aphrodite!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests3.description: &6Aphrodite's Serum&r is a relic that contributes to the reproduction of animals if it is thrown next to them.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests4.subtitle: It looks like a totem of immortality!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests4.description: &6Angelheart Vial&r is a relic that breaks when the owner dies, but heals them and gives positive effects, saving from death.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests5.subtitle: A relic that allows you to fly!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests5.description: &6Rending Gale&r is a relic that allows its owner to fly in the direction of the camera. Keep in mind that it does not cancel the fall damage, unless you look at the ground and use the relic to land safely.
The Rending Gale also can &2attract&r or &2repel&r creatures, or spawn a &alightning&r during a thunderstorm.
You can &2Switch&r between these modes by using a combination of keys &eSHIFT&r + &eLMB&r.
And in order to fly or to spawn lightnings, the relic must be &2charged&r with &afeathers&r.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests6.subtitle: An endless source of water!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests6.description: &6Emperor Chalice&r is a relic which serves as an endless source of water. in addition to that, you can drink from the chalice to restore hunger by sacrificing health.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests7.subtitle: Useful in the Nether!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests7.description: &6Infernal Chalice&r is a relic that can store lava inside, and also protects its owner from lava and fire in exchange for hunger.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests8.subtitle: A unique weapon!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests8.description: &6Magicbane&r is a relic that only has &e16&r durability and is one of the most easily broken weapons that exists in this modpack.
When hit by this blade, there is a&e50%&r chance of imposing one of the following effects: &nConfusion&r, &nBlindness&r, &nSlowness&r, &nWeakness&r.
In addition, if you apply any &2Enchanting&r on the blade, then the level of the enchantment will be added to the relic's &atotal damage&r.
For example, a Magicbane enchanted with fire aspect 2 will have &e2&r additional damage.
It is formally &2golden&r, so the Touchstone of Midas works, and so that it has the same enchantability as gold.
NOTE: &0Magicbane is an artifact from a game called Nethack, which the author of this mod would like to tribute a bit.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests9.subtitle: Technically a magnet!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests9.description: &6Coin of Fortune&r is a relic that attracts items and experience orbs within a radius of 5 blocks to its owner. It is toggleable via a combination of keys &eShift&r + &eRMB.&r
The radius of the relic can be &2tripled&r. To do this, click &eRMB&r with the relic in the hand, which will change the radius to around 15 blocks.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests10.subtitle: An interesting mechanics at the relic!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests10.descriptio: &6Sojourner Staff&r is a relic that absorbs up to &e1500&r torches, and then places them at a great distance.
This relic can be used to place torches/blocks at a distance of up to &e30&r blocks, but at the same time, every &e6&r blocks increases the number of torches/blocks spent by 1.
For example, by placing a torch at a distance of &e30&r Blocks, the relic owner will spend &e6&r torches at once.
If you have both the &6Sojourner Staff&r and the &6Lantern of Paranoia&r, the latter will try to use the internal storage of the staff in order to place the torches.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests11.subtitle: Convenient for traveling!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests11.descriptio: &6Ender Staff&r is a relic that facilitates travel. When you press &eSHIFT&r + &eRMB&r, the relic will begin absorbing Ender pearls to charge. Afterwards, it can spend this charge to teleport its owner. This relic has &2several modes&r that can be switched by pressing &eSHIFT&r + &eLMB&r.
In the &lShort Distance&r mode (an ender pearl icon) the relic will launch a completely ordinary ender pearl, but landing will not inflict damage to its owner.

In the &lLong Distance&r mode (an ender eye icon) the relic will launch a ender pearl that will be less subject to gravity, which contributes to a larger distance of the flight of pearl and, therefore, teleportation of the owner.
In the &lGhost Node&r mode , it teleports the owner to a &2Gost Node&r, to which the staff is tied. To tie the relic to a node, you just need to click &eRMB&r in the same mode.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests12.subtitle: Universal relic!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests12.descriptio: &6Pyromancer's Staff&r is a relic that shoots fire balls, similar to those that ghasts and blazes use. It is charged with blaze powder or fire charges.
In addition, it &2prevents&r the owner from being hit by fireballs sent by blazes or ghats. It will also extinguish flames around the owner, but only when it's turned off.
And finally, Pyromancer Staff &2will replace&r its owner's &2Flint and Steel&r.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests13.subtitle: Useful in the Nether!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests13.descriptio: &6Ice Magus Rod&r is a relic that absorbs (&eSHIFT&r + &eRMB&r) snowballs from the inventory of its owner and shoots them at the enemy. It is more effective against opponents from the &cNether&r.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests14.subtitle: An improved version of the Ice Magus Rod!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests14.descriptio: &6Glacial Staff&r is a relic, which is an improved version of the Ice Magus Rod. This relic also shoots snowballs that are useful against fiery opponents.

But the Glacial Staff also has an &2additional ability&r - it turns water into dense ice, and lava into obsididan, if the owner holds the staff in his hand. These blocks melt when they are outside the radius of the action of the staff.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests15.subtitle: It loves a large number of items!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests15.descriptio: &6Infernal Tear&r is a relic that consumes (&eSHIFT&r + &eRMB&r) items that the owner has the most of in their inventory, and exchanges them for experience.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests16.subtitle: Useful for storing experience!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests16.descriptio: &6Hero Medallion&r is a relic that stores experience. When activating the relic, it will absorb the experience of its owner. If it is not activated, then by pressing the RMB will return 1 level of experience to the owner.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests17.subtitle: An improved version of the totem of immortality!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests17.descriptio: &6Pheonix Down&r is a relic that can resurrect its owner after a deadly blow, while giving them fully restored health and many positive effects.
After using the relic, it turns back into an &2Angel Feather&r.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests18.subtitle: Useful in the Nether!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests18.descriptio: &6Infernal Claws&r is a relic that absorbs fire damage, but not lava, by taking owner's hunger.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests19.subtitle: It will come in handy under the water surface!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests19.descriptio: &6Kraken Shell&r is a relic that absorbs the drowning damage, but uses owner's hunger for this.
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests20.subtitle: Useful for gold items!
gloomyrise.reliquary.quests20.descriptio: &6Touchstone of Midas&r is a relic that restores the durability of gold items by using glowstone from the owner's inventory.
gloomyrise.artifacts.title: &6Artifacts
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests0.subtitle: Useful in battle and travel!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests0.description: &6Umbrella&r is an artifact that can be used in combat like a shield, or like a planner while you travel. One item, two uses!
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests1.subtitle: Endless?
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests1.description: &6Everlasting Beef&r is a food that you can eat an infinite number of times.
It can be obtained, with a small chance, when killing a cow.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests2.subtitle: Timeless?
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests2.description: &6Eternal Steak&r is a fried everlasting beef. It can also be eaten an infinite number of times, but the steak restores more hunger and saturation.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests3.subtitle: I'm not sure if that's useful...
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests3.description: &6Plastic Drinking Hat&r is an artifact that allows you to eat and drink faster.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests4.subtitle: I'm not sure if that's useful...
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests4.description: &6Novelty Drinking Hat&r is an artifact that allows you to eat and drink faster.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests5.subtitle: Great if you love the ocean!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests5.description: &6Snorkel&r is an artifact that allows its owner to breathe under water. This makes the exploration of water depths more safe and convenient.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests6.subtitle: Useful in the night!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests6.description: &6Night Vision Goggless&r is an artifact that gives you the ability to see in the dark. The night is no longer dark and scary...
They can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests7.subtitle: Useful when trading!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests7.description: &6Villager Hat&r is an artifact that gives you additional discounts when trading with villagers.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests8.subtitle: Useful when hunting monsters!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests8.description: &6Superstitious Hat&r is an artifact that gives you an additional level of looting when killing mobs.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests9.subtitle: Useful when mining!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests9.description: &6Lucky Scarft&r is an artifact that gives its owner an additional level of luck, which allows you to more profitably mine various resources.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests10.subtitle: For what? Unknown ...
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests10.descriptio: &6Scarf of Invisibility&r is an artifact that hides you from curious eyes.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests11.subtitle: Support from Femida!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests11.descriptio: &6Cross Necklace&r is an artifact that increases the duration of invincibility after taking damage.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests12.subtitle: Support from Hermes!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests12.descriptio: &6Panic Necklace&r is an artifact that increases your speed after receiving damage. A fairly useful artifact that will help to fight more effectively and retreat after taking serious damage.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests13.subtitle: Support from Zeus!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests13.descriptio: &6Shock Pendant&r is an artifact that can shock your enemies.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests14.subtitle: Support from Hephaestus!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests14.descriptio: &6Flame Pendant&r is an artifact that can set your enemies on fire.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests15.subtitle: Support from Ares!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests15.descriptio: &6Thorn Pendant&r is an artifact that can damage your enemies.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests16.subtitle: Support from Poseidon!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests16.descriptio: &6Charm of Sinking&r is an artifact that allows you to move freely underwater.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests17.subtitle: More convenience!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests17.descriptio: &6Cloud in a Bottle&r is an artifact that provides you with a double jump, making your movement around the world faster and more convenient.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests18.subtitle: I wonder who used to own it?
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests18.descriptio: &6Obsidian Skull&r is an artifact that gives you temporary invulnerability from fire.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests19.subtitle: Useful when fighting witches!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests19.descriptio: &6Antidote Vessel&r is an artifact that reduces the duration of negative effects, allowing you to survive longer in fights, especially against witches.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests20.subtitle: Could be one of the most useful artifacts!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests20.descriptio: &6Universal Attractor&r is an artifact that attracts nearby object to you, making your life a little easier.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests21.subtitle: Careful not to break it!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests21.descriptio: &6Crystal Heart&r is an artifact that gives you additional health, thus improving survivability.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests22.subtitle: 0_0 amazing!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests22.descriptio: &6Helium Flamingo&r is an artifact that allows you to swim through air for a limited time! To do this, you need to go into the water, wait until Flamingo is charged, and then start swimming in the water and fly out of it into the air. Incredible!
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests23.subtitle: Simple, but effective!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests23.descriptio: &6Digging Claws&r is an item that increases your basic mining level and mining speed in general, making your life a little easier.
They can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests24.subtitle: Simple, but useful!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests24.descriptio: &6Feral Claws&r is an artifact that increases your attack speed, improving the total damage.
They can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests25.subtitle: They make you stronger!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests25.descriptio: &6Power Glove&r is an artifact that gives you 4 additional damage when fighting.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests26.subtitle: Just don't set yourself on fire!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests26.descriptio: &6Fire Gauntlet&r is an artifact that sets the mobs you attack on fire. The main rule when wearing this artifact is not to set fire to yourself.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests27.subtitle: An amazing item!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests27.descriptio: &6Pocket Piston&r is an artifact that increases the knockback you inflict on mobs.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests28.subtitle: Magic or trickery?
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests28.descriptio: &6Vampiric Glove&r is an artifact that will restore your health when damaging the enemy.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests29.subtitle: A pleasant addition!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests29.descriptio: &6Golden Hook&r is an artifact that increases the amount of experience mobs drop.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests30.subtitle: Convenience!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests30.descriptio: &6Aqua Dashers&r is an artifact that allows you to walk above the surface of various liquids, although it only works when you're sprinting.
They can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests31.subtitle: Light as a rabbit!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests31.descriptio: &6Bunny Hoppers&r is an artifact that increases your jump height, and also completely removes fall damage.
They can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests32.subtitle: Quite cute, but not for everyone!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests32.descriptio: &6Kitty Slippers&r is an artifact which scares creepers off. Finally, you don't have to worry about unexpected explosions from behind.
They can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests33.subtitle: Nice shoes!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests33.descriptio: &6Runnig Shoes&r is an artifact that increases your speed, probably because they are very comfortable.
They can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests34.subtitle: Steady yourself!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests34.descriptio: &6Steadfast Spikes&r is an artifact that absorbs the knockback you receive, making it great for combat.
They can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests35.subtitle: Great for swimmers!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests35.descriptio: &6Flippers&r is an artifact that increases your speed in the water, making you faster under the layers of water.
They can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests36.subtitle: The most important artifact!
gloomyrise.artifacts.quests36.descriptio: &6Whoopee Cushion&r is an artifact that is guaranteed to increase the amount of fun you will have playing.
It can be found in &2treasuries&r of various dungeons.
gloomyrise.create.title: &6Mechanics
gloomyrise.create.quests0.subtitle: Create!
gloomyrise.create.quests0.description0: Andesite alloy is the main component in the Create mod. You will need a lot of it, good thing that it's rather easy to make, albeit slow.
gloomyrise.create.quests0.tasks0.title: Andesite alloy
gloomyrise.create.quests1.description0: The shaft is used to transmit kinetic energy to various mechanisms. And also for some crafts.
gloomyrise.create.quests1.tasks0.title: Shaft
gloomyrise.create.quests2.description0: The gear, as well as the shaft, is used to transmit kinetic energy, but more accurately. And also for some crafts.
gloomyrise.create.quests2.tasks0.title: Gear
gloomyrise.create.quests3.description0: A large gear is also used to transmit kinetic energy, and is also used in some crafts.
gloomyrise.create.quests3.tasks0.title: Big gears
gloomyrise.create.quests4.description0: The water wheel produces kinetic energy using streams of water.
gloomyrise.create.quests5.description0: A mechanical press can compress objects under it.
gloomyrise.create.quests6.description0: A brass sheet can be created by throwing a brass ingot to a working mechanical press. Brass sheets are needed for many things, as well as for other mods.
gloomyrise.create.quests6.tasks0.title: Brass Sheet
gloomyrise.create.quests7.description0: The gold sheet can be created by throwing a gold ingot under a working mechanical press. Gold sheets are needed for many things, as well as for other mods.
gloomyrise.create.quests7.tasks0.title: Golden sheet
gloomyrise.create.quests8.description0: An iron sheet can be created by throwing an iron ingot to a working mechanical press. Iron sheets are needed for many things, as well as for other mods.
gloomyrise.create.quests8.tasks0.title: Iron sheet
gloomyrise.create.quests9.description0: A copper sheet can be created by throwing a copper ingot to a working mechanical press. Copper sheets are needed for many things, as well as for other mods.
gloomyrise.create.quests9.tasks0.title: Copper sheet
gloomyrise.create.quests11.description0: A wrench is a useful tool for working with kinetic contraptions. It can be used for fine turning and dismantling components.
gloomyrise.create.quests12.description0: A brass or Andesite casing can be used to decorate the shafts. And also they are used in many crafts.
gloomyrise.create.quests12.tasks0.title: Brass Casing
gloomyrise.create.quests13.description0: The handle produces a small amount of kinetic energy, which is enough to use mechanisms. But for this you need to work with your hands.
gloomyrise.create.quests14.description0: An array of mechanical crafters can be used to automate the creation of any recipe.
gloomyrise.create.quests14.tasks0.title: Mechanical Crafter
gloomyrise.create.quests15.description0: The propeller is needed to create an encased fan.
gloomyrise.create.quests16.description0: A whisk is needed to create a mechanical mixer.
gloomyrise.create.quests17.description0: The mechanical mixer mixes(who would've thought) shapeless recipes, and also has unique recipes. But to use a mechanical mixer, you need a basin.
gloomyrise.create.quests18.description0: Encased fans use the rotation force to create air flow. The strength and direction of the flow depend on the applied rotation.
gloomyrise.create.quests19.description0: A brass or Andesite casing can be used to decorate the shafts. And also they are used in many crafts.
gloomyrise.create.quests19.tasks0.title: Andesite Casing
gloomyrise.create.quests20.description0: The gearbox is a more compact mechanism for transmitting rotary force.
gloomyrise.create.quests22.description0: Mechanical bearings attach the blocks in front of them. Upon receipt of the rotary force, the bearing and the construction will become one.
gloomyrise.create.quests23.description0: When the rotation force is supplied, the mechanical drill will break the blocks in front of itself.
gloomyrise.create.quests24.description0: The copper casing can be used to decorate copper pipes. And also they are used in many crafts.
gloomyrise.create.quests24.tasks0.title: Copper Casing
gloomyrise.create.quests25.description0: Fluid pipes can connect two or more sources and consumers of liquid. As well as driven by mechanical pumps, pipes can transport liquids.
gloomyrise.create.quests25.tasks0.title: Fluid pipe
gloomyrise.create.quests26.description0: Fluid tanks can be used to store large volumes of liquid.
gloomyrise.create.quests26.tasks0.title: Fluid tank
gloomyrise.create.quests27.description0: The hose pulley can be used to fill or drain large volumes of fluid.
gloomyrise.create.quests28.description0: Item drain can remove fluid from an item.
gloomyrise.create.quests29.description0: The spout can fill suitable items located under it with liquid.
gloomyrise.create.quests30.description0: A tasty treat for your hard working blaze burner.
gloomyrise.create.quests31.subtitle: Yum
gloomyrise.create.quests32.subtitle: Yum
gloomyrise.create.quests33.subtitle: Yum
gloomyrise.create.quests34.subtitle: For log and plank!
gloomyrise.create.quests34.description0: The perfect drink to get the day started - motivating and saturating.
gloomyrise.create.quests35.description0: Mechanical saw can process many items.
gloomyrise.create.quests36.subtitle: Can't have enough hands
gloomyrise.create.quests37.description0: The depot can serve as a stationary element of the conveyor.
gloomyrise.create.quests38.description0: A pair of crushing wheels can grind objects very effectively. It's important to note that the power of rotation should rotate them into each other.
gloomyrise.create.quests38.tasks0.title: Crushing wheel
gloomyrise.create.quests39.description0: Powdered obsidian can be obtained by putting obsidian though a pair of crushing wheels.
gloomyrise.create.quests39.tasks0.title: Powdered Obsidian
gloomyrise.create.quests40.description0: The chromatic compound is created in a mechanical mixer, but do not forget to prepare a blaze cake.
gloomyrise.create.quests40.tasks0.title: Chromatic Compound
gloomyrise.create.quests41.description0: Ghost Steel is obtained in the void. You can either break bedrock or go to the End, because this material can only be created in the void.
gloomyrise.create.quests41.tasks0.title: Ghost steel
gloomyrise.create.quests42.description0: Refined Radiance is forged from absorbed light. To create it, you need to throw a chromatic compound near lava.
gloomyrise.create.quests42.tasks0.title: Refined Radiance
gloomyrise.create.quests43.description0: The wand of symmetry perfectly reflects the placed blocks on the same axis. A very convenient tool when building large structures.
gloomyrise.create.quests44.description0: Just a cool block, can be used as a decoration.
gloomyrise.create.quests44.tasks0.title: Shadow Casing
gloomyrise.create.quests45.description0: Just a cool block, can be used as a decoration.
gloomyrise.create.quests45.tasks0.title: Shining Casing
gloomyrise.create.quests46.description0: Cinder flour can be obtained by grinding netherack in a pair of crushing wheels.
gloomyrise.create.quests46.tasks0.title: Cinder Flour
gloomyrise.create.quests47.description0: The blaze cake base is needed to create a full blaze cake.
gloomyrise.create.quests48.subtitle: Rattle 'em!
gloomyrise.create.quests48.description0: Launches your home-grown vegetables at your enemies. Can be powered with air pressure from a copper backtank.
gloomyrise.create.quests49.subtitle: You can get the butter yourself now :)
gloomyrise.create.quests50.description0: With the force of rotation, an deployer can imitate the player’s actions.
gloomyrise.create.quests51.description0: The accuracy mechanism is created in a very unique way. You have to build a line of deployers with special items. After that, you need to throw a gold plate on the conveyor.
gloomyrise.create.quests51.tasks0.title: Accuracy mechanism
gloomyrise.create.quests52.description0: Mechanical hands which can move items.
gloomyrise.create.quests53.description0: The rotation speed controller, oddly enough, controls the speed of rotation.
gloomyrise.create.quests54.description0: Furnace engines create the power of rotation while the connected furnaces are burning.
gloomyrise.create.quests55.description0: Flywheels are necessary to generate power of rotation using furnace engines.
gloomyrise.create.quests56.subtitle: It's time to rest :)
gloomyrise.create.quests56.description0: You have already traveled a long way, so you need to take a break. But don't sit around for too long, as there is still a lot of work to do!
gloomyrise.create.quests57.description0: In order for the wheels to rotate into each other, you should create a reverse mechanism and use the lever.
gloomyrise.creative.title: &6Creative Items
gloomyrise.danks.title: &6Bottomless Storages
gloomyrise.danks.quests0.subtitle: The time has come for the warehouse!
gloomyrise.danks.quests6.subtitle: Marvelous!
gloomyrise.danks.quests7.subtitle: Turn your Dank into a chest!
gloomyrise.danks.quests7.description0: You can put your dank in a placed dock. After that, your Dank will become a stationary chest, not a backpack!
gloomyrise.decoration.title: &6Decoration
gloomyrise.end.title: &6Adventures in The End
gloomyrise.end.quests0.subtitle: It's time to reach The End...
gloomyrise.end.quests0.description0: Eye of Ender is needed to find and activate the portal to The End.
gloomyrise.end.quests0.tasks0.title: Eye of Ender
gloomyrise.end.quests10.subtitle: Golem's heart!
gloomyrise.end.quests10.description0: &6The Void Core&r drops from the &6Ender Golem&r.
gloomyrise.end.quests10.description1: The void core has the ability to summon a &aVoid Rune&r by pressing &eRMB&r.
gloomyrise.end.quests11.subtitle: Great!
gloomyrise.end.quests11.description0: It is necessary to kill the &6Ender Golem&r.
gloomyrise.end.quests12.subtitle: Music!
gloomyrise.end.quests13.subtitle: Protects The End!
gloomyrise.end.quests13.description0: It is necessary to kill a mob &6Ender Guardian&r.
gloomyrise.end.quests14.subtitle: Pulls in creatures!
gloomyrise.end.quests14.description0: &6Gauntlet of Guard&r drops from the &6Ender Guardian&r.
gloomyrise.end.quests14.description1: Gauntlet of Guard can &aPull In&r various creatures.
gloomyrise.first_steps.title: &6First Steps
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests0.descripti: The first thing you will need in this world is wood! I advise you to collect as much as possible, because you will need a lot in the future.
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests1.subtitle: Your workplace!
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests1.descripti: From the boards that can be obtained from logs, you can create a crafting table, using which you can create many interesting things, such as wooden tools, chests, and much more!
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests2.descripti: The cobblestone can be obtained by mining stone with a pickaxe. For now it's mostly useful for new tools and a furnace, but there will be more.
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests3.descripti: A pattern is needed to create special stations and parts of tools.
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests4.descripti: Campfire can fry food up to 4 pieces at the same time, which is much more effective than the furnace.
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests5.title: New tools
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests5.descripti: Using these stations, you can create your own tools! Tools are created in parts, and these parts can be made from different materials to assemble the best tool.
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests6.subtitle: Your first storage.
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests6.descripti: In the chest you can store things, and that’s it ...
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests7.descripti: Part chest can store tool parts to save space in other chests. Who would've thought.
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests8.descripti: The barrel can store items just like the chest, but barrels can be placed everywhere, and chests need space above.
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests9.descripti: With the help of the furnace, various materials can be melted.
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests10.descript: The blast furnace can melt ores two times faster than the normal one, however it can't cook food. It can also be used to create a seared melter.
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests11.subtitle: A small smeltery!
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests11.descript: A seared melter is needed to created a smelter controller. To do this, you need to put the seared melter above a seared tank and pour some lava in it. Next, you need to melt copper and, using a tap, pour it into a seared casting basin over a seared heater.
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests12.descript: Seared bricks can be made from cement by putting it through a furnace. These bricks will be needed to create various parts of the smeltery.
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests13.title: Smeltery
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests13.descript: To build a smeltery, you need 3x3 or 5x5 seared bricks walls(and the floor) of any height. Then, replace some of the bricks with a smeltery controller, a fuel tank and the drains. With this smeltery you can double the resources from your ores!
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests14.descript: Iron ore can be obtained in the mine at an altitude of 2-61. By melting iron ore, you can get an iron ingot.
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests15.subtitle: Acquire hardware!
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests15.descript: An iron ingot is needed for many things, but now you can create an iron pickaxe.
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests16.descript: With the help of an iron pickaxe, you can get more hard rocks and ores, for example, diamond.
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests17.subtitle: Cover me in diamonds!
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests17.descript: Diamonds can be obtained using an iron pickaxe in a mine at an altitude of 1-16. Diamonds are very valuable and are needed for many things and mechanisms, but now you can create a diamond pick.
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests18.descript: With the help of diamond pickaxe, you can get obsidian, as well as an diamond pickaxe which is better than the previous ones.
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests19.subtitle: Protect yourself
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests19.descript: Using the shield, you can protect yourself from monsters. Especially from arrows and explosions.
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests20.descript: The workbench that retains its inventory. Very convenient.
gloomyrise.first_steps.quests21.title: Iron Chest
